title: CPR source code (BeenyHail/CPR)
summary: Public code of CPR (paper SRC-0123 / SRC-0402) at commit 9ecd685 (2025-11-01). Licence file: CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial); the README's licence badge still carries a template attribution ('Jane Doe'). Step 1 (basic CID mapping) runs without a model; Step 2 queries a local Ollama server with model llama3.1:8b and sets no temperature or seed. Written for Windows paths. Run here only as a black box (OBS-0704); no code copied.
